block.name: Clear Glass
block.description: Craft any sand directly into clear glass at the Builder's Workbench, Windows category. Shape six glass blocks into sixteen panes at the same bench.

pane.name: Clear Glass Pane
pane.description: A thin clear pane. Connects to neighboring clear glass panes and blocks. Craft at the Builder's Workbench, Windows category.

preservation.bottleRecipe: Potion_Empty remains one Sands -> one bottle at the native Furnace in ten seconds.
preservation.glassRecipe: One Sands -> one glass at the existing Builder's Workbench, Windows category, in two seconds. No fuel or intermediate item.
